Fait d'un élément une cible de dépôt, avec des règles pour ce qu'elle accepte et des hooks pour le dépôt.
Rend un élément déplaçable — glissement libre, ou vers les cibles de dépôt qui l'acceptent.
Fait d'un conteneur une liste triable — un brouillon qui se réordonne pendant le glissement et qui est réécrit au dépôt.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import FileChip from './FileChip.vue';
import Zone from './Zone.vue';
import { FILES } from './files';

/** Which zone each file is in. */
const where = reactive<Record<string, string>>(Object.fromEntries(FILES.map((file) => [file.id, 'desk'])));
const filesIn = (zone: string) => FILES.filter((file) => where[file.id] === zone);
const move = (zone: string, file: Key) => (where[String(file)] = zone);
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider>
    <div class="zones">
      <Zone title="Desktop" rule="takes anything" class="desk" @drop="move('desk', $event)">
        <FileChip v-for="file in filesIn('desk')" :key="file.id" :file="file" />
      </Zone>
      <Zone title="Images" rule="accept: 'image'" accept="image" @drop="move('images', $event)">
        <FileChip v-for="file in filesIn('images')" :key="file.id" :file="file" />
      </Zone>
      <Zone title="Media" rule="accept: ['image', 'audio']" :accept="['image', 'audio']" @drop="move('media', $event)">
        <FileChip v-for="file in filesIn('media')" :key="file.id" :file="file" />
      </Zone>
      <Zone title="Archive" rule="disabled: true" disabled @drop="move('archive', $event)" />
    </div>
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<style scoped>
.zones {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  width: min(720px, 100%);
}

.desk {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .zones {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDraggable } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import type { DeskFile } from './files';

const props = defineProps<{ file: DeskFile }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// The type is what drop targets check in `accept`.
const { isDragging } = makeDraggable(el, { id: () => props.file.id, type: () => props.file.type });
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="el" class="chip" :class="{ dragging: isDragging }">
    <span class="icon">{{ file.icon }}</span>
    {{ file.name }}
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 12px 7px 8px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: Canvas;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent),
    0 3px 8px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
  font: 12px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
  touch-action: none;
}

.chip:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #42b883;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* The overlay carries the chip: the original stays as a faint outline. */
.chip.dragging {
  opacity: 0.3;
}

.icon {
  font-size: 15px;
}
</style>

export interface DeskFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'image' | 'text' | 'audio';
  icon: string;
}

export const FILES: DeskFile[] = [
  { id: 'photo', name: 'beach.png', type: 'image', icon: '🏖️' },
  { id: 'notes', name: 'notes.md', type: 'text', icon: '📝' },
  { id: 'song', name: 'demo.mp3', type: 'audio', icon: '🎵' },
  { id: 'logo', name: 'logo.svg', type: 'image', icon: '🎨' },
];

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, type AcceptRule, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ title: string; rule: string; accept?: AcceptRule; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ drop: [file: Key] }>();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const { isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(el, {
  accept: props.accept,
  disabled: () => !!props.disabled,
  // A plain drop target moves nothing itself: the drop is yours to apply.
  onDrop: (e) => emit('drop', e.active.id),
});
</script>

<template>
  <section
    ref="el"
    class="zone"
    :class="{ accepting: isAccepting, over: isOver && isAccepting, refusing: isOver && !isAccepting, disabled }"
  >
    <header>
      <strong>{{ title }}</strong>
      <code>{{ rule }}</code>
    </header>
    <div class="files"><slot /></div>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>

  display: flex;

  border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent);
  border-radius: 14px;
  transition:
    border-color 0.15s,
    background 0.15s;
}

}

.zone.over {
  border-style: solid;

}

}

.zone.disabled {
